question: What will be the ending value of the ICE BofA US High Yield Option-Adjusted Spread for these biweekly periods of Q3 2026? (Sep 21 - Oct 2)

calls.reasoning: Status quo: HY OAS printed 2.65 on 2026-09-11, inside a 2.60-2.85 range since May and in the richest decile of series history (long-run median ~4.50). Reference class is 3-week-ahead changes in this series; the trailing-12m median change is -0.03, so a pure random walk lands near 2.62. I nudge the median up to 2.67 because the downside is floored (cycle low 2.60, 2.53 would be a multi-decade record) while the upside is open, and the window contains the post-FOMC tape (~83% priced 25bp HIKE on Sep 16-17, with 10y yields at post-2007 highs), the heaviest post-summer issuance calendar at minimal concessions, and Q3 index rebalancing on Sep 30. Counterargument for tighter: the 2026 grind has been relentless, carry demand absorbed the March widening (3.42 -> 2.60 in five months), and quarter-end marks often print firm. No human market prices this quantity - no Kalshi/Polymarket/Manifold contract on HY OAS levels found - so no crowd blend. Distribution is right-skewed; 3% mass above 3.505 for a genuine risk-off event on the Aug-2024 / Apr-2025 template.

Reference class: 14-business-day changes in this series from tight-regime starts (<2.90), which have a median near +0.02 and a right-skewed spread. I anchor the median at 2.69, a few bp above spot for late-Sept/early-Oct seasonality, month-end index rebalance, and the mild upward drift already visible off the 2.60 Aug-28 low. Both tails are real: a new cycle low below 2.60 is live (spot was there 2.5 weeks ago) so p10=2.57, while the widening tail is fatter - 10y Treasury yields at/near 5% for the first time since 2007, ~80-85% odds on a Sep-16 Fed HIKE, AI-concentration hedging and CCC spreads >1000bp - so p90=2.96. Offsetting: the Oct-1 shutdown risk is gone (CR through Dec 11 enacted, market <1%), VIX is near 2026 lows, and demand absorbed a heavy September calendar. No human market prices this quantity, so no crowd anchor. p_above_upper=1.2% prices a disorderly rates/AI-led risk-off of the April-2025 kind (that episode did +170bp in under two weeks); mass below 1.745 has no mechanism - the series' all-time low since 1996 is ~2.33 - so I omit it.
